headline: IMF Urges Uzbekistan to Continue Phased Utility and Energy Tariff Hikes
summary: The International Monetary Fund reiterated support for further utility and energy tariff increases in Uzbekistan, urging the government to align consumer prices with actual generation and supply costs.
why: Transitioning from state-subsidised energy to cost-reflective utility tariffs is vital for Uzbekistan's public finances and attracting private energy sector investment.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Tariff reforms reduce state fiscal subsidies while creating near-term upward pressure on domestic inflation.
